article.title: Why did Cuba become healthier during the economic meltdown of the 1990s?
article.excerpt: One should interpret anything about Cuba, or coming out of Cuban data, with extreme caution. Nonetheless I thought this was interesting enough to pass along: The economic meltdown should logically have been a public health disaster.
